(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (nz (find (lambda (v) (!= v 0))
                          (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                     (map (lambda (c) (at g r c)) (range 0 w)))
                                   (range 0 h)))))
           (build-grid (* 1 h)
                       (* 1 w)
                       (r c)
                       (let ((v (at g (mod r h) (mod c w)))) (if (= v 0) nz 0))))))
